D5/S3/Quantum/Foundation/FiniteTraceDist.name: D5.S3.Quantum.Foundation.FiniteTraceDistance.traceDistance
D5/S3/Quantum/Foundation/FiniteTraceDist.signature: def traceDistance (rho sigma : DensityState ι) : ℝ

D5/S3/Quantum/Foundation/FiniteTraceDist.name: D5.S3.Quantum.Foundation.FiniteTraceDistance.traceDistance_contract
D5/S3/Quantum/Foundation/FiniteTraceDist.signature: theorem traceDistance_contract (channel : QuantumChannel ι ι) (rho sigma : DensityState ι) : traceDistance (channel.mapState rho) (channel.mapState sigma) ≤ traceDistance rho sigma

D5/S3/Quantum/Foundation/FiniteTraceDist.name: D5.S3.Quantum.Foundation.FiniteTraceDistance.traceDistance_le_one
D5/S3/Quantum/Foundation/FiniteTraceDist.signature: theorem traceDistance_le_one (rho sigma : DensityState ι) : traceDistance rho sigma ≤ 1

D5/S3/Quantum/Foundation/FiniteTraceDist.name: D5.S3.Quantum.Foundation.FiniteTraceDistance.traceDistance_nonneg
D5/S3/Quantum/Foundation/FiniteTraceDist.signature: theorem traceDistance_nonneg (rho sigma : DensityState ι) : 0 ≤ traceDistance rho sigma

D5/S3/Quantum/Foundation/FiniteTraceDist.name: D5.S3.Quantum.Foundation.FiniteTraceDistance.traceDistance_symm
D5/S3/Quantum/Foundation/FiniteTraceDist.signature: theorem traceDistance_symm (rho sigma : DensityState ι) : traceDistance rho sigma = traceDistance sigma rho

D5/S3/Quantum/Foundation/FiniteTraceDist.name: D5.S3.Quantum.Foundation.FiniteTraceDistance.traceDistance_triangle
D5/S3/Quantum/Foundation/FiniteTraceDist.signature: theorem traceDistance_triangle (rho sigma tau : DensityState ι) : traceDistance rho tau ≤ traceDistance rho sigma + traceDistance sigma tau
